mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MOKU_USER (EMAIL, PASSWORD, NAME, PHONE, VERIFIED, MANNER_TEMP, PRODUCT_COUNT, FAVORITE_COUNT, CHAT_COUNT) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{verified}, #{mannerTemp,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{productCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{favoriteCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{chatCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, NAME, PHONE, VERIFIED, IS_LOCATION_VERIFIED AS isLocationVerified, VERIFIED_PLACE AS verifiedPlace, VERIFIED_AT AS verifiedAt, MANNER_TEMP AS mannerTemp, PRODUCT_COUNT AS productCount, FAVORITE_COUNT AS favoriteCount, CHAT_COUNT AS chatCount FROM MOKU_USER WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND PASSWORD = #{password}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MOKU_USER WHERE EMAIL = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MOKU_USER WHERE PHONE = #{phone}
mapper.update: UPDATE MOKU_USER SET IS_LOCATION_VERIFIED = #{isLocationVerified}, VERIFIED_PLACE = #{verifiedPlace}, VERIFIED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
